note: All 205 pivots are Early Modern Irish annal entries (Four Masters, Loch Ce, Ulster; OCR); partners mostly Greek prose (Galen, Plutarch, Polybius), Latin Cato, OHG Tatian/Notker, ON documents. Only shared lexemes in generic contexts, considered and rejected: marbhadh/gonaid ~ Ved. han- (#14, #114), derbrathair ~ Arm. elbayr + death (#4), Ir. dan art ~ Skt dana gift (#84), earrach + gheimhreadh ~ AVP vasanta + hemanta (#172: Irish date range vs Vedic list of seasons, no shared syntax or figure), clu and enech/uaisle obit formulae (Irish-internal). No congruent cross-branch collocation, so no lead needed corpus search; no claims.
